notes: Read all 318 numbered source lines before editing. This is a non-visual best-effort error-telemetry utility: no JSX, no Recharts/Leaflet/lucide, no old web UI components, no i18n strings, and no unit-suffixed fields. The only API path '/api/v1/web-errors' (L18) is preserved verbatim. All pure logic (bucketing/coalescing, offline send buffer, feedback ring buffer, payload builders) is ported byte-for-byte; the browser boundaries are crossed via globalThis accessors so the module runs under Hermes and behaves identically under react-native-web.

L1-13 file-level JSDoc ported verbatim, followed by a native-port header documenting every browser-boundary adaptation and the two inlined dependencies. L18-25 constants ENDPOINT, COALESCE_WINDOW_MS (60_000), MAX_BUFFER_SIZE (20), FEEDBACK_RING_SIZE (10) ported verbatim with the surviving comment.

L15-16 `import { isRateLimitError, isUpstreamUnavailableError } from './resilience'` and `import { isReportingAllowed } from './cookieConsent'` are the structural change: neither module is ported into the native parity tree yet, so importing them would dangle and fail tsc. Following the dateFormat.ts->isFiniteNumber and FeedbackModal.tsx->FeedbackErrorReport precedents, the three predicates are inlined native-safe and the module is left import-free.

Inlined isRateLimitError/isUpstreamUnavailableError reproduce resilience.ts L475-506 exactly via the source's own bundle-split duck-type checks (name==='RateLimitError'&&status===429&&typeof retryAfterSec==='number'; and the 503/'upstream' variant). The web `instanceof` fast-path is dropped because a real RateLimitError/UpstreamUnavailableError instance also satisfies the duck-type, making it behavior-equivalent for shouldSkip(); the type-guard return was relaxed to boolean since errorReporter never uses the narrowing. Verified against the web errorReporter.test.ts cases that construct RateLimitError('429',30,'vehicles') / UpstreamUnavailableError('503',30,'tesla') and expect no POST.

Inlined isReportingAllowed + getStoredConsent reproduce cookieConsent.ts L163-166 + L58-68: when requireCookieConsent is false reporting is always allowed; otherwise it requires getConsent()==='accepted'. getStoredConsent reads CONSENT_STORAGE_KEY 'teslasync:consent:v1' from globalThis.localStorage (columnOrderStore.ts idiom), returning 'unknown' on absent storage or read failure. Under Hermes (no localStorage) consent collapses to 'unknown' — the documented native CookieConsentBanner behaviour — which correctly blocks consent-gated POSTs while leaving the non-consent default (false) fully functional.

L27-46 FeedbackErrorReport interface (snake_case occurred_at/source) + ErrorSource union ('window'|'promise'|'react'|'query') ported verbatim with both /** */ docs. L48-59 FrontendErrorPayload + BufferedSend ported verbatim. L61-84 ReporterState (installed, buckets Map, buffer, feedbackRing, enabledOverride, requireCookieConsent) + the `state` singleton initializer ported verbatim with every comment.

L86-94 setErrorReporterConsentRequirement (Boolean(required) coercion) ported verbatim. L96-108 isEnabled: `import.meta.env.PROD` (Vite-only) -> isProdBuild() reading `__DEV__===false` via globalThis (production ⇔ release bundle; absent flag is treated as non-prod so the reporter stays silent, matching the web dev/test default). enabledOverride short-circuit and isReportingAllowed gate preserved with the original comments, so __setErrorReporterEnabledForTests(true) still forces sending in tests.

L110-112 isOffline: `navigator.onLine` -> globalThis.navigator?.onLine, returning true(offline) only when onLine===false, so an absent/onLine-less navigator (Hermes) stays online exactly like the web `typeof navigator !== 'undefined'` guard. L114-139 nameOf/messageOf/stackOf ported byte-for-byte (Error instanceof checks, string fallthrough, JSON.stringify-in-try, length guards).

L141-151 shouldSkip ported verbatim, now calling the inlined isRateLimitError/isUpstreamUnavailableError plus the AbortError/CanceledError name checks and the null/undefined short-circuit. L153-164 bucketKey (source\u0000name\u0000message\u0000route NUL-joined key) and shouldCoalesce (now-last<COALESCE_WINDOW_MS) ported verbatim with comments.

L166-183 sendPayload: `fetch` -> globalThis.fetch (React Native ships a global fetch so the POST path stays functional). The `typeof fetch !== 'function'` guard, POST method, Content-Type header, JSON body, and `keepalive: true` init are all preserved; the .catch()+try/catch double-swallow keeps it from ever throwing into its caller. Matches the web tests for fetch-failure swallow and fetch-unavailable no-crash. L185-191 flushBuffer (splice-drain + per-item send) ported verbatim.

L193-243 reportFrontendError ported verbatim — shouldSkip gate, payload build (route via getRoute() = globalThis.location?.pathname ?? '/'; userAgent via getUserAgent() = globalThis.navigator?.userAgent ?? '', mirroring the web `typeof window/navigator` ternaries; occurredAt new Date().toISOString()), unconditional pushFeedbackReport (even when isEnabled() is false), isEnabled gate, bucketKey+Date.now() coalescing with state.buckets.set, and the offline branch that drops the oldest when buffer length >= MAX_BUFFER_SIZE before pushing. All comments preserved.

L245-263 pushFeedbackReport (push + trim to FEEDBACK_RING_SIZE via splice) and getRecentReportsForFeedback (returns state.feedbackRing.slice() fresh copy) ported verbatim with docs. L265-293 installGlobalErrorReporting: idempotency + `state.installed = true` set BEFORE the window check (preserved ordering), then `window.addEventListener` -> getWindowLike() which resolves globalThis.window only when it exposes addEventListener; under Hermes it returns undefined and the function early-returns exactly like the source's `typeof window === 'undefined'` branch. The error/unhandledrejection/online handlers and the e.error??new Error(e.message) synthesis are preserved with loose `unknown` event narrowing (no lib.dom ErrorEvent/PromiseRejectionEvent types in the RN tsconfig).

L295-318 test-only exports __resetErrorReporterForTests (clears installed/buckets/buffer/feedbackRing/enabledOverride and restores requireCookieConsent=false), __setErrorReporterEnabledForTests, __getBufferedCountForTests ported byte-for-byte with the underscore-convention comment block. No DOM module, browser HTML element, Recharts, Leaflet, react-leaflet, or old web-UI component is imported (the module has zero imports).

Style normalized for the native @react-native eslint/prettier config (singleQuote, trailingComma all, bracketSpacing false, arrowParens avoid, semicolons, curly braces on all single-line if-returns) via `eslint --fix`; the lone `no-void` warning on the fetch call was removed by binding the promise to `sent` and calling sent.catch(). Behavior is unchanged.
